Some treatment protocols for thiamin supplementation include
thiamin prescribed at 200 mg/day orally for six weeks, while 
others recommend an initial parenteral dose of 100 mg fol-
lowed by daily supplementation.177, 179–181
Other Nutrients of Concern Additional conditionally 
essential nutrients that have been examined to determine their 
possible role in treatment for heart failure include arginine, car-
nitine, and taurine (as mentioned earlier, they have been linked
to cardiac cachexia as well). Hawthorn, an herbal supplement, 
has also been studied as a complementary treatment for heart 
failure but is without signiﬁ cant demonstrated beneﬁ t (see the
